description: Scrubbed, bright and clinical, which people never expect and which is the first thing she wants them to notice. A reclining chair with a fresh sheet of paper down it, a tray on an arm, an autoclave on the counter with a log book beside it and a date in the log for today. One wall is a mirror. The other three are bare, deliberately, because she does not want you choosing off a wall while you are sitting in the chair.
name: No Regerts — The Room
